Shares of the California-based software-driven cloud networking solutions provider climb 0.017% to $181.08 after the bell on Tuesday. ANET closed the regular session up 8.76% at $181.05, according to Benzinga Pro data. Volume for the day rose to 11.91 million shares, compared with an average daily volume of 8.72 million shares, indicating elevated trading activity.
articles._zh_headline: 为什么 Arista Networks (ANET) 股票隔夜走势？
articles._zh_summary: Arista Networks Inc.（纽约证券交易所股票代码：ANET）股价周四呈现走势。周二收盘后，这家总部位于加州的软件驱动云网络解决方案提供商的股价上涨 0.017%，至 181.08 美元。根据 Benzinga Pro 数据，ANET 常规交易日收盘上涨 8.76%，至 181.05 美元。当日成交量增至 1,191 万股，而日均成交量为 872 万股，表明交易活动有所增加。
